call_points.text: May need another manufacturing unit in India; looking at targets but nothing concrete.
US order book strong; Q2 revenue expected better than Q1 and Q3 the strongest.
Q1 gross margin benefited from favourable product mix, low-cost inventory and forex.
Cash will be kept for acquisitions, not invested in market instruments; more European deals being explored.
No timeline for the next USFDA inspection; one plant was audited less than 12 months ago.
US tariff talk treated as wait-and-watch; management said it would not put much weight on it.

guidance.statement: We are targeting ₹4,000 crores in revenue in the next 2 years.
We expect revenue growth to be between 15% to 20% in FY27.
Revenue target of ₹4,000 Cr within two years
Europe revenue of about ₹1,000 Cr within five years
US revenue target of $300 million next, then $400 million over about five years
QliniQ revenue of ₹150-175 Cr in FY27

operating_notes.text: Incorporated two new wholly owned subsidiaries: Marksans Pharma (Europe) Limited in Ireland and Marksans (Canada) Inc. in Canada.
US and North America revenue reached ₹1,533 Cr in FY26, contributing ~52% of total revenue.
Entered into an agreement to acquire 100% of Netherlands-based QliniQ B.V. for €7.5 million.
North America revenue reached ₹1,533 crores in FY26, up 24% YoY.
Teve facility is operating close to 50% capacity with potential for 40% to 50% further growth.
UK and Europe Q1FY27 revenue was ₹356 Cr, up 74.7% YoY; excluding QliniQ's ₹44 Cr, the region grew 53.1%.
About 65-70% of sales are manufactured in India; the UK mix is about 55% Rx and 45% OTC, while Europe is expected at 80-85% Rx.
Goa Teva facility is at ₹50-plus Cr revenue against a projected ₹80 Cr, about 60-65% of the target.

timeline.summary: Promoters **Mark Saldanha** and **Sandra Saldanha** declared no encumbrance on their shares in Marksans Pharma Limited under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) on April 02, 2026.
Marksans Pharma scheduled its Q4FY26 earnings conference call for May 27, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹856.11 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹148.13 Cr.
Marksans Pharma reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹856.11 Cr and FY26 total income of ₹3,033.47 Cr, meeting guidance.
Marksans Pharma entered into a definitive agreement to acquire 100% of Netherlands-based QliniQ B.V. for €7.5 million on June 1, 2026.
Marksans Pharma hosted its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call on May 27, 2026, highlighting record annual revenue crossing ₹3,000 Cr.
On its 13 August 2026 Q1FY27 call, Marksans held FY27 guidance at 15-20% revenue growth and 20-21% EBITDA margin and guided gross margin to 55-56% from Q1's 59.1%.
